evidence_scope: worker containers on one Docker host; capacities, speeds, and links are emulated, not independent hardware
kind_config:
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: ts-cluster
nodes:
- role: control-plane
- role: worker
  labels:
    node-type: CPU_OPT
    ts.capacity/cpu: '1'
    ts.capacity/memory: '640'
    ts.io/cooling-class: STANDARD
    ts.io/thermal-throttle-c: '100'
    ts.io/kind-profile: balanced
  kubeadmConfigPatches:
  - "kind: JoinConfiguration\nnodeRegistration:\n  name: ts-node-cpu\n"
- role: worker
  labels:
    node-type: MEM_OPT
    ts.capacity/cpu: '1'
    ts.capacity/memory: '640'
    ts.io/cooling-class: STANDARD
    ts.io/thermal-throttle-c: '100'
    ts.io/kind-profile: balanced
  kubeadmConfigPatches:
  - "kind: JoinConfiguration\nnodeRegistration:\n  name: ts-node-mem\n"
- role: worker
  labels:
    node-type: IO_OPT
    ts.capacity/cpu: '0.5'
    ts.capacity/memory: '384'
    ts.io/cooling-class: STANDARD
    ts.io/thermal-throttle-c: '100'
    ts.io/kind-profile: balanced
  kubeadmConfigPatches:
  - "kind: JoinConfiguration\nnodeRegistration:\n  name: ts-node-io\n"
- role: worker
  labels:
    node-type: GENERAL
    ts.capacity/cpu: '0.5'
    ts.capacity/memory: '384'
    ts.io/cooling-class: STANDARD
    ts.io/thermal-throttle-c: '100'
    ts.io/kind-profile: balanced
  kubeadmConfigPatches:
  - "kind: JoinConfiguration\nnodeRegistration:\n  name: ts-node-edge\n"
